title: Spanish Tortilla
description: A traditional Spanish omelette made with potatoes, onions, and sometimes ham. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cut the potatoes into small pieces and boil them in salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside to cool.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooled potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the onions and garlic.
Break the Spanish tortilla into small pieces and add them to the skillet.
Use a spatula to gently stir the mixture and heat it through.
Serve the Spanish tortilla hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
